_about: Every external research artifact the TrafficTwin code actually uses, grouped by contribution, with the files that use it. Served by GET /api/references and rendered as the References page; docs/REFERENCES.md is generated from this file by scripts in backend/app/api/references.py (make references). Items marked context_only are published numbers quoted for comparison, not code that runs here.

items.title: Graph WaveNet for Deep Spatial-Temporal Graph Modeling
items.authors: Wu, Z., Pan, S., Long, G., Jiang, J., Zhang, C.
items.used_for: The canonical forecaster: 207-node METR-LA checkpoint, verified against the published MAE, drives every predictive arm of the closed loop.
items.code: nnzhan/Graph-WaveNet (pinned in upstream/UPSTREAM_PINS.yaml); trained through BasicTS

items.title: Diffusion Convolutional Recurrent Neural Network: Data-Driven Traffic Forecasting
items.authors: Li, Y., Yu, R., Shahabi, C., Liu, Y.
items.used_for: Source of the METR-LA and PEMS-BAY releases, the Gaussian-kernel sensor graph, the chronological 70/10/20 split and the published Historical-Average floors.

items.title: Exploring Progress in Multivariate Time Series Forecasting: Comprehensive Benchmarking and Heterogeneity Analysis
items.authors: Shao, Z., Wang, F., Xu, Y., et al.
items.used_for: BasicTS is the training and evaluation harness for Graph WaveNet, DCRNN, STID and STAEformer; no per-model training loop is written in this repository.

items.title: Spatial-Temporal Identity: A Simple yet Effective Baseline for Multivariate Time Series Forecasting
items.authors: Shao, Z., Zhang, Z., Wang, F., Wei, W., Xu, Y.
items.used_for: Benchmark model run under the same protocol (Phase-1 gate G3).

items.title: STAEformer: Spatio-Temporal Adaptive Embedding Makes Vanilla Transformer SOTA for Traffic Forecasting
items.authors: Liu, H., Dong, Z., Jiang, R., et al.
items.used_for: Benchmark model, and the source of the one-protocol leaderboard the comparison table is checked against.

items.title: Chronos: Learning the Language of Time Series
items.authors: Ansari, A. F., Stella, L., Turkmen, C., et al.
items.used_for: Pretrained zero-shot univariate forecaster offered for cities with only a short recorded corridor history (Dhaka); kept pretrained, never retrained; its negative result is reported.

items.title: OpenCity: Open Spatio-Temporal Foundation Models for Traffic Prediction
items.authors: Li, Z., Xia, L., Shao, Z., et al.
items.used_for: Cross-city foundation-model comparison; its pre-training corpus decides which cities may be called zero-shot.

items.title: XGBoost: A Scalable Tree Boosting System
items.used_for: Classical non-deep baseline on the same chronological split (with scikit-learn RandomForest).

items.title: Scikit-learn: Machine Learning in Python
items.used_for: RandomForest baseline and metric utilities.

items.title: Attention Based Spatial-Temporal Graph Convolutional Networks for Traffic Flow Forecasting
items.authors: Guo, S., Lin, Y., Feng, N., Song, C., Wan, H.
items.used_for: Provenance of the PEMS04 / PEMS08 releases used in the cross-city corpus bookkeeping.

items.title: Cross-Node Federated Graph Neural Network for Spatio-Temporal Data Modeling
items.authors: Meng, C., Rambhatla, S., Liu, Y.
items.used_for: Reference federated forecaster that the V2X-impairment study degrades.

items.title: Communication-Efficient Learning of Deep Networks from Decentralized Data
items.authors: McMahan, H. B., Moore, E., Ramage, D., Hampson, S., Agüera y Arcas, B.
items.used_for: The FedAvg aggregation rule implemented in the federated forecast.

items.title: STGCN, MTGNN, GTS, GMAN, STNorm, PDFormer, AGCRN, HI (published METR-LA / PEMS-BAY numbers)
items.venue: as re-run under one protocol by STAEformer (Liu et al., CIKM 2023, Table 1)
items.used_for: Leaderboard context only: their published MAE values appear in the comparison table; none of these models runs here.

items.title: METR-LA — 207 loop detectors, Los Angeles, 5-minute speeds, March–June 2012
items.authors: released with DCRNN (Li et al., ICLR 2018)
items.used_for: The only dataset the headline forecast claim rests on; the 207-node checkpoint is validated on its held-out split. Speed-only: no flow counts, so SUMO demand cannot be calibrated from it (src/pipeline/v2x/METR_LA_FLOW_NOTE.md).

items.title: PEMS-BAY — 325 detectors, Bay Area, 5-minute speeds
items.authors: released with DCRNN (Li et al., ICLR 2018)
items.used_for: Second benchmark city for the forecasting gate.

items.title: UTD19 — Understanding traffic capacity of urban networks
items.authors: Loder, A., Ambühl, L., Menendez, M., Axhausen, K. W.
items.used_for: Traffic-science foundation: flow, occupancy, accumulation, production and the macroscopic fundamental diagram carried into the platform's invariants and units.

items.title: OpenStreetMap, queried through the Overpass API
items.used_for: Road network of every simulated city (Dhaka R1, the four Los Angeles corridors): netconvert with the OSM typemap, left-hand traffic for Dhaka.

items.title: Nominatim geocoder (OpenStreetMap)
items.venue: https://nominatim.org — usage policy: 1 request/s, attribution required
items.used_for: Free-text origin and destination → coordinates for the trip analysis; falls back to the built-in place list.

items.title: Traffic-related tweets dataset (with Dabiri & Heaslip, 'Developing a Twitter-based traffic event detection model using deep learning architectures', ESWA 2019)
items.used_for: Training data for the incident / congestion text classifier (off the canonical closed-loop path).

items.title: Modeling an ITS Management Solution for Smart Highways with Eclipse MOSAIC
items.authors: Schrab, K., Protzmann, R., Radusch, I.
items.used_for: Eclipse MOSAIC 25.2 is the only empirical grounding of the V2X latency and loss profiles: the official Barnim example was reproduced and its ITS-G5 latency distribution feeds the `mosaic` channel profile; the Dhaka R1 penetration sweep (DENM tx/rx, delivery ratio) runs in MOSAIC.

items.title: ETSI EN 302 663 — Intelligent Transport Systems (ITS); ITS-G5 Access layer specification for Intelligent Transport Systems operating in the 5 GHz frequency band
items.used_for: The ITS-G5 access layer that MOSAIC's ad-hoc (SNS) channel model represents; every latency number labelled ITS-G5 in this project inherits that model, not a radio measurement.

items.title: ETSI EN 302 637-2 — ITS; Vehicular Communications; Basic Set of Applications; Part 2: Specification of Cooperative Awareness Basic Service (CAM)
items.used_for: The periodic vehicle status uplink (VEHICLE_STATUS every 10 s) is the project's simplified analogue of the CAM service.

items.title: ETSI EN 302 637-3 — ITS; Vehicular Communications; Basic Set of Applications; Part 3: Specifications of Decentralized Environmental Notification Basic Service (DENM)
items.used_for: The hazard broadcast (DENM, 1 Hz re-broadcast, geocast radius) in the MOSAIC penetration sweep; ROUTE_RECOMMENDATION with a TTL follows the same expiry idea.

items.title: Simulated V2X channel (this project)
items.venue: deterministic emulator: latency, jitter, loss, TTL, penetration by seeded hash
items.used_for: Explicitly a SIMULATED V2X EMULATOR, not radio hardware and not a 5G / DSRC stack; profiles ideal, mosaic, lat100…lat5000, loss05…loss20, degraded.

groups.title: C · Traffic simulation and control (digital twin)

items.title: Microscopic Traffic Simulation using SUMO
items.authors: Alvarez Lopez, P., Behrisch, M., Bieker-Walz, L., Erdmann, J., Flötteröd, Y.-P., Hilbrich, R., Lücken, L., Rummel, J., Wagner, P., Wießner, E.
items.used_for: Eclipse SUMO 1.27.1 is the simulator behind every outcome number; TraCI (setRoute, setMaxSpeed, saveState/loadState with --save-state.rng) is the only actuation path; duarouter, randomTrips, netconvert and sumolib are its tools.

items.title: Traffic Simulation for All: A Real World Traffic Scenario from the City of Bologna
items.authors: Bieker, L., Krajzewicz, D., Morra, A., Michelacci, C., Cartolano, F.
items.venue: Modeling Mobility with Open Data, Springer
items.used_for: Official SUMO scenario run unmodified as the Lab-01 baseline; source of the warm-up lesson in the control benchmark config.

items.title: A digital twin in transportation: Real-time synergy of traffic data streams and simulation for virtualizing motorway dynamics
items.authors: Kušić, K., Schumann, R., Ivanjko, E.
items.used_for: Method pattern for synchronising a SUMO twin from measured counts (calibrator-based dynamic demand).

items.title: Modeling and Analyzing Urban Networks and Amenities with OSMnx
items.used_for: Cross-validation of the netconvert road graph against an independent OSM extraction (Lab 02).

items.title: Max pressure control of a network of signalized intersections
items.used_for: Classical signal-control baseline in the control benchmark.

items.title: Traffic Assignment Manual
items.authors: Bureau of Public Roads, U.S. Department of Commerce
items.used_for: The BPR volume-delay function whose alpha/beta coefficients price background load in the generalized route cost.

items.title: The Surprising Effectiveness of PPO in Cooperative Multi-Agent Games
items.authors: Yu, C., Velu, A., Vinitsky, E., Gao, J., Wang, Y., Bayen, A., Wu, Y.
items.used_for: MAPPO signal-control arms of the control benchmark (pinned official code).

items.title: URB: Urban Routing Benchmark for RL-equipped Connected Autonomous Vehicles
items.used_for: Routing benchmark challenger pinned for the control gate.

items.title: The Probable Error of a Mean
items.used_for: The paired-seed 95 % confidence interval on percentage change in vehicle-hours uses the t critical value for n−1 degrees of freedom (table hard-coded for n = 2…13).

items.title: An Introduction to the Bootstrap
items.used_for: Percentile bootstrap (10 000 resamples over seeds) as the alternate interval on the mean per-arm change.

items.title: Individual Comparisons by Ranking Methods
items.used_for: Two-sided signed-rank test on paired seeds (with the honest note that n = 3 gives a minimum p of 0.25, so the interval is the informative statistic).

items.title: SciPy 1.0: fundamental algorithms for scientific computing in Python
items.used_for: scipy.stats implementation of the signed-rank test.

items.title: Array programming with NumPy
items.used_for: All numerics.

items.title: PyTorch: An Imperative Style, High-Performance Deep Learning Library
items.used_for: Model training and inference for every deep forecaster.

items.title: Google Maps Platform — Routes API (computeRoutes, TRAFFIC_AWARE_OPTIMAL)
items.used_for: External LIVE reference travel time for the trip analysis when a key is configured. Never ground truth, never a training or validation target; recorded corridor states are replayed (labelled RECORDED) when the key is absent or denied.

items.title: MapLibre GL JS 4.7.1
items.used_for: All map rendering in the web application.

items.title: Esri World Street Map tiles (ArcGIS Online)
items.used_for: Background tiles behind the traffic layers.

items.title: FastAPI / Uvicorn
items.used_for: The API server that serves the application and every evidence endpoint.
